answer_status: No fixed numeric ground truth for fresh live responses. Use actual dated payloads to verify derivation and presentation; issuer-document truth is a separate source audit.
acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent retained-source/generic routes may pass if authorized budgets, exact schemas, source scope, math and presentation are correct. Record efficiency separately, not as semantic failure.
hard_failures: Unapproved extra provider calls or Drishti calls
Invented values, dates, company or source provenance
INR/crore scale mismatch or percent/formula mislabel
Claiming provider records are independently verified originals
Invented DCF forecasts or a point estimate without assumptions

guard_expectations.G01: Ask for missing company/context, zero data calls.
guard_expectations.G02: Explain missing DCF assumptions, zero data calls; local catalog inspection allowed.
guard_expectations.G03: Use current status, no provider calls; local tools remain distinct from auth/quota.
guard_expectations.D00: Discover relevant company capability and fresh-fetch route without data calls; absence of provider auth is not absence of local catalog.

report_expectations.F01: Two input rows plus margin result; continuing/group definition explicit.
report_expectations.F02: Two revenue input rows plus absolute_change and percentage_change; use current-previous only for absolute change.
report_expectations.F03: Readiness/valuation fields matter even if report.rows is empty; do not call an empty numeric rows array a failed readiness response.
report_expectations.F04: Read the actual margin_result payload; run completion is not the result and request time is not trade date.
